selection.strongest_feasible_alternative: Use the already measured single-mutant screen and kinetics to choose among tested Zn45 variants.
selection.why_this_followup_changes_a_decision: It closes the reported truncated-cluster NEB method as a justified predictor of the known Zn45-v2 gain and identifies ensemble and chemical-state requirements that static confidence cannot supply.
selection.stop_rule: No new energy model, MD run, or broad archive acquisition follows from these retrospective examples alone.

experimental_comparisons.interpretation: Activity improvement is measured; improved E77 positioning is an author hypothesis. An isolated F48W MD or NEB comparison is not established in the retained evidence.

experimental_comparisons.substrate_context: Cognate S_ZnO7 peptide in sfGFP-mScarlet reporter
experimental_comparisons.comparison_limit: Different scaffold and substrate; not a matched Zn45 mutational comparison.

local_reaction_energy.evidence_level: author computational prediction, not measured barrier or free energy
local_reaction_energy.state_segment: General-base proton abstraction and Zn-water nucleophilic attack toward the tetrahedral intermediate. The full hydrolytic cycle is not modeled.
local_reaction_energy.rate_determining_assumption: This segment is assumed to control turnover; the paper also discusses hydrogen-bond rearrangement and product release as alternative rate-limiting steps in metalloproteases.
local_reaction_energy.initial_state: AF3 starting structures, neutral-pH protonation with manually adjusted metal ligands and proton-transfer residues
local_reaction_energy.cluster_rule: Substrate plus residues with at least one atom within 5 angstrom of substrate
local_reaction_energy.method: Reactive polarizable MACE-extension potential trained on OMOL25 DFT; optimized cluster NEB/CI-NEB path with 11 images
local_reaction_energy.reported_quantity: Delta E double-dagger = maximum path-image energy minus optimized reactant energy; main text calls this an enthalpic activation barrier. Entropic contributions are absent, so this is not a measured or complete Delta G barrier.

cross_enzyme_author_observation.limit: Retrospective cross-scaffold comparison on different substrates does not validate within-scaffold activity ranking.

omissions: Three of the four Zn45-v2 substitutions in the chosen cluster
Full reaction path and alternative rate-limiting steps

decision.reason: The method explicitly fails to capture the known 30-fold gain and omits most mutated sites and relevant physical contributions.

Michaelis_dynamics.evidence_level: author classical MD prediction, interpreted retrospectively beside kinetics
Michaelis_dynamics.method: AMBER24 ff14SB, explicit TIP3P solvent, bonded Zn coordination parameters from MCPB/B3LYP cluster calculations

initial_states.astacin: Author Michaelis model derived from PDB 1QJI; 1QJI itself is an inhibitor complex. Preparation into the simulated Michaelis state is not independently reconstructed here.

Michaelis_dynamics.chemistry_boundary: Fixed-topology classical Michaelis-state dynamics; no peptide hydrolysis or turnover is observed in these trajectories. The bonded Zn model does not independently test metal binding or ligand exchange.

reported_observables.name: general_base_oxygen_to_nearest_water_hydrogen_distance
reported_observables.Zn45_status: Broad fluctuations reported; no numeric WT mean transcribed from the retained text
reported_observables.atom_scope: General-base oxygen and closest hydrogen of Zn-bound water; exact per-frame atom/minimum convention not reconstructed

Michaelis_dynamics.causal_limit: The WT-v2 comparison changes four residues together. It is consistent with improved preorganization but does not assign the MD effect to F48W alone, prove causality, calibrate a rate predictor, or validate a universal geometry cutoff.

chemical_state_hypothesis.author_inference: Removing a substrate carbonyl hydrogen-bond donor can improve catalysis if that donor stabilizes the ground state more than the transition-state region.
chemical_state_hypothesis.observations: Both substitutions increase measured activity; the original donors were introduced by MPNN.
chemical_state_hypothesis.not_established: No measured or calculated mutation-specific ground-state-versus-transition-state stabilization energy is provided in this retained evidence.

candidate_Atlas_contribution.representation: Connect perturbation and measured turnover to reaction-state-specific interactions and ensemble geometric observables, with model coverage explicitly attached.
testable_features: Differential stabilization of ES versus the tetrahedral-intermediate/transition-state region
Whether a computational region contains the substitutions whose effect it is asked to predict
candidate_Atlas_contribution.immediate_supported_exclusion: Do not substitute the reported 5 angstrom cluster barrier or an extra ground-state hydrogen bond for a validated turnover rank among passing Zn45 variants.
candidate_Atlas_contribution.future_evaluation_requirement: A matched comparison against the existing direct measured-screen/AF3 baseline with structure-state identity, full relevant perturbation coverage, and endpoints fixed before observing new activity. No such prospective test or Atlas advantage is claimed here.
